commitResults.messageTitle: Extract console input into Ui class
commitResults.messageBody: Move Scanner ownership, command reading, and cleanup out of Margit so future UI formatting can be extracted without coupling command logic to console input.

Centralize welcome, farewell, and framed command-response rendering in Ui while preserving Margit's existing command flow and displayed text. This further separates console interaction from application logic.

Move fixed-capacity task storage, count tracking, insertion, removal, and array shifting into TaskList. Update Margit and persistence helpers to use the collection API while preserving task behaviour and saved data.

Move save-file path ownership and task serialization/deserialization into Storage. Margit now coordinates Storage and TaskList without implementing file I/O directly, preserving the existing save format and warning behaviour.

Add private Ui, TaskList, and Storage fields with constructor initialization and task loading. Move the command loop into run() and keep main as a small default-path entry point, establishing the intended application object structure.

Add Parser with command types and arguments, and route Margit's command loop through its parsed results. Keep command-specific validation and task actions in Margit to preserve behavior while separating command interpretation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move indexed command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Have Parser parse mark, unmark, and delete task numbers into optional zero-based indices. Margit now handles only task-list bounds and command effects, while Parser owns invalid-number detection.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move deadline argument parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Add Parser deadline argument types and validation statuses for the required description and /by value. Margit now consumes parsed deadline data while retaining task creation and user-facing responses.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move event argument parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Add Parser event arguments and structural validation for descriptions, /from values, and /to values. Margit now consumes parsed event data while keeping date conversion, task creation, and user interaction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move todo description validation into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Add Parser todo arguments to validate the required description before Margit creates and saves a TodoTask. This keeps simple command-argument validation with the other parsing rules.

Move Margit, UI, parser, storage, and task-domain classes from the default package and nested declarations into the margit package hierarchy. Update imports and public APIs while preserving task behavior and save-file compatibility.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage for parser behavior
commitResults.messageBody: Add comprehensive JUnit 5 tests for Parser command recognition and todo, deadline, event, and indexed-command validation. Document the requirement to maintain tests for roughly the highest-value 50% of methods after every code change.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for task date and list logic
commitResults.messageBody: Cover TaskDateTime parsing and save-file conversion plus TaskList append and removal behavior. These tests extend coverage to core date and collection methods under the high-value 50 percent testing target.

commitResults.messageTitle: Configure Gradle fat JAR for Margit
commitResults.messageBody: Target the CS2103-required Java 17 release, configure the application entry point and shadowJar output as margit.jar, and document building, locating, and running the ignored release artifact.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Javadoc headers for task methods
commitResults.messageBody: Document overridden user-facing, date-matching, and save-format methods in the task model to meet the project-wide Javadoc stretch goal.
